carried_finding_confirmed.detail: walk.WalkedParcel(...) is built with level/blockset_index/block_index/parcel_type/leaf_path/bounds/file_offset/length/parcel/error but no frame_bounds, frame_range or frame_class kwargs. WalkedParcel.__post_init__ (parser/harness/walk.py) defaults frame_bounds to self.bounds (the leaf bbox) when frame_bounds is None. The 075fc99 fixer ('invert against the frame bbox, not the leaf') therefore never takes effect inside this tool's own worker path.
carried_finding_confirmed.impact: harmless for criterion 1's ranges/exceeds_max numbers, because decode and inversion in this tool both use the same (leaf) bbox and raw coordinate values round-trip exactly regardless of which bbox is used for the (unused-here) lat/lon conversion; the tool's test passes only on a synthetic parcel, not confirming frame-awareness
